intent: Trace the population of Sub-Saharan Africa from 1950 through 2019 and its projected range to 2100.

requirements.question: How does the video present the required area marks in this chart?
Trace the historical population of Sub-Saharan Africa from 1950 through 2019.
Show the projected range of the population to 2100.

units.claim: All 3 required area marks are present in the chart: Historical population, Projection lower, Projection upper.
accept: every listed area, reference mark, segment, or category is visible
each mark is correctly bound to its entity or series identity
reject: missing any required area, reference mark, segment, or category
assigning a mark to the wrong entity, panel, or series
replacing a required mark with narration text alone

units.claim: The historical population of Sub-Saharan Africa increased monotonically from 0.1 billion in 1950 to 1.1 billion in 2019.
accept: Historical population rises from 0.1 billion in 1950 to 1.1 billion in 2019.
The historical series shows a sustained increase over the period.
reject: Historical population decreases at any point.

units.claim: The projected population range widens from 1.1–1.25 billion in 2019 to 2.7–5.0 billion in 2100.
accept: The projection band spans from 1.1 to 1.25 billion in 2019 and from 2.7 to 5.0 billion in 2100.
The uncertainty range widens over the projection period.
reject: The lower bound in 2100 is not 2.7 billion.
The upper bound in 2100 is not 5.0 billion.
The projection range narrows over time.

optional_valid: The historical population reached 0.65 billion in 2000 (r51).
The projection lower bound reaches 1.8 billion in 2050 (r102).
The projection upper bound reaches 2.15 billion in 2050 (r184).
unsupported_to_avoid: The population will exactly reach 5.0 billion by 2100.
The historical population grew at a constant rate.

review_notes: The intent asks to trace historical population and show projected range; two units cover these obligations.
